brief: 参考星露谷的人物比例和像素风，保留原角色的发型、发色、面部特征、服装、配饰、年龄与物种；所有角色包括Toby和Momo统一高度与画风。
identityReference: ../uniform/source/roster-{0..5}.png; original Toby/Momo sheets additionally used for group 0
promptGroup0: Use case: identity-preserve + precise-object-edit. EDIT FIRST image, preserve its transparent background and 8-column four-row layout. The user requires these exact original characters, NOT replacements. KEEP all original identities, hair silhouettes, hair colors, facial traits, clothing cuts/patterns/colors, accessories, age cues, gender and species. Do not invent different eyes, beards, ornaments or costumes. Image2 is ONLY a proportion/pixel-technique reference from Stardew Valley; do NOT copy its characters or outfits. Inputs3/4 additionally lock the original Toby/Momo identities for columns1/2. Change ONLY these two things: (A) modestly narrower, less chibi head proportions like Stardew villagers, skull+face width about 85% of current width and head height about 90% of current height, naturally lengthening neck/torso transition within unchanged total seated height. Avoid tiny heads. (B) genuine simple coarse pixel clusters, hard stepped contours, restrained palette, simple small eyes preserving original eye colors. Keep head-to-sole height, hip/hand/foot positions, sitting direction, clothing and long-hair length fixed. No whole-figure size changes. ALL eight characters follow same proportion style, four views each. Rows remain front/left/right/back, 32 figures, generous transparent gutters, actual RGBA transparency; no brown background, checkerboard, text, scenery or chairs. No glossy/painterly gradients. This is a conservative correction of existing character designs, not a creative redesign.

export.note: Export directly at 84px visible height with nearest-neighbor sampling; do not downsample to 42px, which drops eye whites and pupils. Original generated sources unchanged.
